concept.title: Everyone in the community
concept.shortdesc: The whole community or any member of it, without restriction to a particular group of people.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: local community: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (tied to the local area rather than community in general)
local people and residents: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (defined by living locally)
people or anyone: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (no mention of community)
